info.name: Egoola API — Gig
info.description:
Admin-managed Gigs (a seller's service offer: cleaning, photography, logo design, repair) under the Listing module. Same `listings` table as a product, its own endpoints, its own pending list, and its own price model: one SKU ("package") per price type (hourly, daily, weekly, monthly, fixed) instead of options and stock.

A gig has no stock, no options/variants, no brand/model/measurement and no quantity prices (`price_tiers`) — sending any of those is 400. A product id on `/catalog/gigs/` is 404, and the reverse (a seller's service offer on `/catalog/listings/`) is 400.

Key rules:
- A gig needs at least one package (`skus`), or the `price`+`price_type` shortcut for a single package.
- One package per `price_type` — a second `hourly` package is 400; reactivate a hidden one instead.
- `discounted_price` is never higher than `price` (defaults to `price`).
- `rejected` / `changes_requested` require `note`. `Listing.note` holds only the latest change's note.
- Delete is soft; the thumbnail file is deleted, the gallery stays.
- Thumbnail/gallery are a separate multipart API (`listing-files/{id}/`), never the create/update call (JSON only there, multipart is 415).

How to use:
1. Pick the `Egoola - Local` environment (or edit `base_url`).
2. Run **Auth > Admin Login** — its "Tests" script saves the access/refresh tokens.
3. Check the reference-data collection variables `service_category_id` (an active **service** category id — most calls) and `category_id` (an active **product** category id — only used by the negative "service offer on a product category" test). Both must exist in your database (see the Egoola API — Category collection).
4. Run **Gigs**, then **Thumbnail and gallery**, then **Cleanup**, top to bottom ("Run collection") — each request saves the ids the next one needs.
5. The multipart thumbnail/gallery uploads need a real file chosen in the Postman app; skip them in Newman, or point them at a local file path.

Full reference: `docs/admin/admin-gigs-management-guide.md`. Products: the separate Egoola API — Listing collection and `docs/admin/listing-module-guide.md`.

request.description: Public endpoint — no token needed. Returns access + refresh JWTs carrying actor_type=admin. Every Brand and Listing endpoint below is Admin-only.
Exchanges the saved refresh token (14-day life) for a new access token (1-hour life). Run this instead of logging in again once the access token expires.

A gig is a seller's service offer. It is priced by **packages**: one SKU per `price_type` (`hourly`, `daily`, `weekly`, `monthly`, `fixed`), `price` is the rate for that unit. A package has no duration: the buyer chooses it when ordering and pays the rate times it. No options, stock, brand or quantity prices. `catalog_type` and `posted_by_role` are set by the endpoint. An admin-created gig is `approved`; `seller` is optional.

exec: const by = {}; g.skus.forEach(s => by[s.price_type] = s); pm.collectionVariables.set('gig_hourly_sku_id', by.hourly.id); pm.collectionVariables.set('gig_weekly_sku_id', by.weekly.id);

pm.test('rates, and no duration on a SKU', () => { pm.expect(by.hourly.effective_price).to.eql('450.00'); pm.expect(by.weekly.price).to.eql('12000.00'); g.skus.forEach(s => { pm.expect(s).to.not.have.property('duration'); pm.expect(s).to.not.have.property('total_price'); }); });
pm.test('no stock, no options', () => g.skus.forEach(s => { pm.expect(s.stock_qty).to.eql(null); pm.expect(s.variants).to.eql([]); }));
pm.test('product-only fields are not part of a gig', () => ['brand','model','listing_type','measurement','price_tiers'].forEach(k => pm.expect(g).to.not.have.property(k)));

item.name: Create Gig — price shortcut (one weekly package)

request.description: For a one-package gig send `price` and `price_type` on the gig itself (create only; not together with `skus`). `status: pending` puts it in the pending gig list.

exec: pm.test('one weekly package', () => { const s = pm.response.json().skus; pm.expect(s.length).to.eql(1); pm.expect(s[0].price_type).to.eql('weekly'); });

request.description: `price_type` is required on every gig package.

request.description: A gig has at most one package per price type.

request.description: A gig has no stock.

item.name: Create Gig — options on a gig (expect 400)

request.description: A gig package has no options (attributes are for products).
Brand, model, origin, warranty, measurement, condition, listing type, attributes, minimum order quantity and quantity prices are not available on a gig.
A gig needs a service category.
The gig endpoint only handles `service` / `seller_offer`; a different value is a 400.

Filters: `status`, `category`, `seller`, `price_type` (gigs with an active package priced that way), dates (`YYYY-MM-DD`), `search` (title, Bangla title, SKU code). Rows carry `price` / `price_type` of the lowest rate and `image_url`. Products are not in this list.
Packages, media, thumbnail, status history and the info change log.

exec: pm.test('is a service / seller_offer', () => { const g = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(g.catalog_type).to.eql('service'); pm.expect(g.posted_by_role).to.eql('seller_offer'); });

item.name: Retrieve Gig — a gig id on the listing endpoint (expect 404)

request.description: Products and gigs are separate APIs: a gig id on `/catalog/listings/` is a 404.

item.name: Update Gig — change a package (rate) by SKU id

request.description: `skus` merges by `id`: only the fields sent change. SKUs are never deleted.

exec: pm.test('rate changed', () => { const s = pm.response.json().skus.find(x => x.id === Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('gig_hourly_sku_id'))); pm.expect(s.price).to.eql('550.00'); });

item.name: Update Gig — add a monthly package

request.description: An item without an `id` adds a package (needs `price` and `price_type`).

item.name: Update Gig — a second hourly package (expect 400)

request.description: One package per price type, hidden ones included.
Packages are hidden with `is_active: false`, never deleted.

exec: pm.test('hidden package kept', () => { const s = pm.response.json().skus.find(x => x.id === Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('gig_weekly_sku_id'))); pm.expect(s.is_active).to.eql(false); });

request.description: `catalog_type` and `posted_by_role` cannot be changed after creation.

item.name: Update Gig — price at the top level (expect 400)

request.description: Prices are changed through `skus`.
Gigs waiting for a decision, newest request first. Cursor pagination: follow `next` / `previous`, there is no `count`. Products have their own pending list.
`rejected` and `changes_requested` need a `note`.

exec: pm.test('rejected with note', () => { const g = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(g.status).to.eql('rejected'); pm.expect(g.note).to.eql('Add a clear description'); });

request.description: Only gigs are touched; ids of products or jobs are ignored. Products use `/catalog/listings/bulk-moderate/`.

Both optional. `thumbnail`: one JPG / PNG / WEBP (10 MB), `400` if the gig already has one (use PATCH). `media_file`: repeat per file (JPG, PNG, WEBP, GIF, MP4, PDF). An empty request is allowed (`201`, nothing changes). **Select real files by hand in the Postman app** (a shared collection cannot carry file paths; under Newman the file parts are simply absent). Do not set Content-Type yourself.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 201) { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.test('state returned', () => { pm.expect(b).to.have.property('media'); pm.expect(b).to.have.property('image_url'); }); }

request.description: **Every part is independent.** A new `thumbnail` always replaces the old one (the old file is deleted), whether or not `remove_thumbnail` is sent. `remove_thumbnail=true` alone removes it. `remove_media_ids` (`4,5` or repeated; must be this listing's ids, else `400`) removes gallery files; `media_file` adds new ones in the same call. Enable `remove_media_ids` and put real ids. **Select real files by hand in the Postman app** (a shared collection cannot carry file paths; under Newman the file parts are simply absent). Do not set Content-Type yourself.

item.name: Change files — remove the thumbnail only

request.description: `image_path` / `image_url` become `null`, the file is deleted. Removing when there is none is also `200`.

item.name: Change files — a media id of another listing (expect 400)

request.description: Nothing is changed.
`image_path` / `image_url` are `null` until a thumbnail is uploaded. A thumbnail change appears in `info_change_logs` as `thumbnail`.

exec: pm.test('has thumbnail fields', () => { const g = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(g).to.have.property('image_path'); pm.expect(g).to.have.property('image_url'); });

item.name: Listing create is JSON only — multipart (expect 415)

request.description: Create and update of listings and gigs no longer take files.
Soft delete (`204`); the thumbnail file is removed.
